TITLE: Auxiliary boiler furnace internal inspection
WORK_REMARK: Auxiliary boiler furnace was opened and internally inspected during the port stay. 1) The refractory lining of the furnace floor and side walls was visually examined. Fine surface lines were observed on the front wall refractory. 2) Judgement criteria applied: a surface line narrower than 1 mm and shorter than 100 mm is recorded as a hairline and monitored at the next inspection. A line wider than 3 mm, or any line showing displacement or spalling of the surrounding material, is judged as a crack and repaired before the next voyage. 3) The observed lines measured 0.5 mm wide and about 60 mm long with no displacement, therefore they were recorded as hairlines under observation. 4) Burner tip and diffuser were cleaned. Water side was inspected through the manhole and no scale build-up was found.

TITLE: Central cooler sea water side cleaning
WORK_REMARK: Central fresh water cooler sea water side was opened for cleaning. 1) The inlet strainer was found approximately 30% blocked with marine growth, shells and fine sand. 2) Tube ends were inspected. Barnacle attachment was observed at the tube ends on the inlet side, covering about 15% of the tube bore. 3) Tubes were cleaned by high pressure water jetting at 250 bar. 4) Zinc anodes were checked. Two anodes were consumed by more than 50% and were renewed. The renewal criterion applied is consumption exceeding 50% of the original weight. 5) Gaskets were renewed and the cooler was pressure tested at 4.5 bar for 30 minutes with no leakage. 6) After restoring, the cooling water outlet temperature dropped from 38 degC to 33 degC.

TITLE: Main Engine(Diesel) 1 - clean the compressor side  (dry or wet)

TITLE: Life boat launching appliance inspection
WORK_REMARK: Life boat launching appliance was inspected in accordance with the maker's guideline and the ship's maintenance and inspection log. 1) The davit structure was examined for corrosion and deformation. 2) Wire ropes were inspected over their full length. The renewal criterion applied is more than 10% of the wires broken in any length of eight diameters, or a diameter reduction exceeding 10% of the nominal diameter. 3) The brake was tested by lowering the empty boat and the brake held the load without slipping. 4) The on-load release gear was examined and the hook setting was confirmed. 5) The limit switch operation was confirmed and the boat was recovered by the winch motor. 6) All moving parts were greased with the specified grease.

TITLE: M/E fuel injection valve overhaul
WORK_REMARK: Main engine fuel injection valves were overhauled at the scheduled running hours. 1) Each valve was removed and the nozzle was inspected for carbon deposit and erosion of the spray holes. 2) Opening pressure was tested on the test bench. The specified opening pressure is 380 bar. Valves opening below 360 bar were adjusted by shim. 3) Spray pattern was checked. All spray holes must give an even conical spray. One valve showed an uneven pattern from a partially blocked hole and the nozzle was renewed. 4) Seat tightness was verified by holding 350 bar for 10 seconds with no dripping. 5) After installation, exhaust gas temperatures were monitored at 75% load and the deviation between cylinders was within 20 degC.

TITLE: D/G crankcase inspection and oil mist detector check
WORK_REMARK: Generator engine crankcase was opened for internal inspection at the scheduled interval. 1) Main bearings and crank pin bearings were examined and no abnormal wear was found. 2) Crankshaft deflection was measured at all units. The maximum deflection recorded was 0.08 mm against the allowable limit of 0.15 mm. 3) Tie rod tightening was confirmed by hydraulic jack at the specified pressure. 4) The oil mist detector was function tested. The alarm set point is 0.4 mg/L of oil mist density and the alarm operated correctly at the test. 5) The crankcase relief valve flame arrester was cleaned and the sealing was confirmed. 6) Lube oil sump was checked for water content and the result was below 0.1%.

TITLE: Sea chest strainer cleaning
WORK_REMARK: Sea chest strainer was opened and cleaned during the port stay. 1) The strainer basket was lifted and found approximately 40% blocked with weed, shells and plastic debris. 2) The basket was cleaned and inspected for corrosion. No perforation was found. 3) Zinc anodes inside the sea chest were examined. Consumption was approximately 60% and the anodes were renewed. 4) The sea chest internal coating was inspected and light blistering was noted on the aft side, which was recorded for touch-up at the next dry docking. 5) The cover gasket was renewed and the chest was flooded and checked for leakage. 6) After restoring, the sea water pump suction pressure improved from minus 0.35 bar to minus 0.18 bar.

TITLE: Generator Engine(Diesel) 1 - clean centrifugal l.o filter
WORK_REMARK: clean centrifugal l.o filter was carried out on the Generator Engine(Diesel) 1 in accordance with the maker's instruction manual. All accessible parts were dismantled and cleaned. TITLE: L.O purifier overhaul and assembly
WORK_REMARK: Lube oil purifier was overhauled in accordance with the maker's maintenance schedule. 1) The bowl was dismantled and all sealing rings were renewed. 2) The bowl disc stack was cleaned with approved solvent and inspected for erosion. 3) On reassembly, the large lock nut was tightened to 280 N.m using a torque wrench. 4) The match marks on the bowl body and bowl hood were aligned. If the match marks are displaced by more than one graduation, the bowl must be rebalanced and the impeller renewed. 5) Vertical shaft height was checked and found within the specified tolerance of plus or minus 0.5 mm. 6) After assembly the unit was run up and vibration was measured at 2.8 mm/s, below the alarm setting of 7.1 mm/s.

TITLE: D/G turbocharger water washing
WORK_REMARK: Turbocharger water washing was carried out on the generator engine in accordance with the maker's instruction manual. 1) Compressor side cleaning: Engine load was kept between 50% and 85%. 0.4 L of fresh water was injected over 10 seconds through the washing nozzle. 2) Turbine side cleaning: Engine load was reduced below 40% before injection. Water pressure was set to 2.5 bar and injection time was 10 minutes. 3) Turbine inlet temperature was monitored throughout and kept under 430 degC (normal range 350-430 degC, maximum 530 degC). 4) After washing, the generator was kept running for 10 minutes to dry and stabilize. 5) Exhaust gas temperature deviation between cylinders was checked after the work and found within 30 degC. No abnormality was observed.

TITLE: Aux. Boiler 2 - check & maintenance oil burning equipment(swirer, sprayer. etc)

TITLE: Mooring winch hydraulic oil renewal
WORK_REMARK: Mooring winch hydraulic system oil was renewed at the scheduled interval. 1) The old oil was drained and a sample was taken for analysis. 2) The return line filter element was renewed. The differential pressure indicator had shown 3.5 bar against the change setting of 3.0 bar. 3) The Y type strainer screen in the supply line was removed and cleaned. The screen mesh was found intact. Where a screen is found torn, the cause is normally traced to excessive differential pressure from a clogged filter, and both the screen and the filter element are renewed together. 4) The system was refilled with 320 L of the specified hydraulic oil, ISO VG 68. 5) After refilling the system was bled and the brake holding force was tested.

TITLE: Main air compressor valve inspection
WORK_REMARK: Main air compressor suction and discharge valves were inspected at 2,000 running hours. 1) Valve plates were examined for cracks and the valve seats for pitting. 2) Valve lift was measured. The specified lift is 1.2 mm with a wear limit of 1.6 mm. One discharge valve measured 1.7 mm and the plate and spring were renewed. 3) The automatic drain trap was checked. The drain solenoid was found to operate every 15 minutes as set. 4) Cooler tubes were cleaned and the safety valve was tested to lift at 32 bar. 5) After overhaul, the charging time from 0 to 30 bar was measured at 18 minutes, within the design value of 20 minutes.
